definitions.explanation: The part of a tool or utensil that is held.
The long part connecting the working end to the handle.

⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柄|え}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧。

notes:
{柄|え} refers to the graspable part of a tool, utensil, or weapon. It applies to any item with a handle or shaft.

KANJI READINGS:
- え: handle, grip (this entry)
- ⟦がら→柄：02609_gara⟧: pattern, design; build, character (different word entirely)

COMMON USES:
- ⟦{傘|かさ}→傘：00639_kasa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柄|え}: umbrella handle
- ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柄|え}: sword hilt/grip
- ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柄|え}: pot handle
- ⟦{斧|おの}→斧：12726_ono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柄|え}: axe handle
- ⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柄|え}: frying pan handle

NOTE:
{柄|え} is distinct from ⟦{取|と}っ{手|て}→取っ手：24070_totte⟧ (handle, knob), which refers to handles designed to be gripped and pulled, such as door handles or drawer pulls. {柄|え} is for elongated handles on tools and utensils.
